declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

declarations.text: I carry the death of Jesus in my body so that His life is displayed through me. His resurrection power lives in my flesh.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We always carry around in our body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

declarations.text: I do not lose heart. My light and momentary troubles are producing for me an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.

declarations.text: I am God's co-worker. He calls me to holiness. I purify myself and complete sanctification in the fear of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, since we have these promises, dear friends, let us purify ourselves from everything that contaminates body and spirit, perfecting holiness out of reverence for God.

declarations.text: Godly grief produces repentance in me. I do not run from conviction. I let it do its transforming work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation and leaves no regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.

declarations.text: I give generously and cheerfully. God loves a cheerful giver and I am one. My generosity is an act of worship.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

declarations.text: God supplies seed for me to sow and multiplies what I plant. Every act of generosity I release returns in abundance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will also supply and increase your store of seed and will enlarge the harvest of your righteousness.

declarations.text: I do not wage war with worldly weapons. My weapons carry divine power to demolish every stronghold.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world. On the contrary, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.

declarations.text: I take every thought captive and make it obedient to Christ. My mind is not a battleground that the enemy controls.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We demolish arguments and every pretension that sets itself up against the knowledge of God, and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

declarations.text: I boast in the Lord alone. My strength is not my own. My credibility comes from what God has built in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But, 'Let the one who boasts boast in the Lord.' For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.

declarations.text: His grace is sufficient for me. His power is made perfect in my weakness. I glory in my weakness so Christ's power rests on me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'

declarations.text: When I am weak, then I am strong. I have learned this truth and I stand on it without apology.
declarations.bibleVerseText: That is why, for Christ's sake, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

declarations.text: I examine myself. I test whether I am in the faith. Christ is in me and I walk in that assurance daily.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Do you not realize that Christ Jesus is in you?

declarations.text: The grace of Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Spirit are mine. I live inside this holy communion.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.

declarations.text: I walk by faith, not by sight. My steps are not governed by what is visible. I move at the voice of God, not the verdict of my circumstances.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we live by faith, not by sight.

declarations.text: I am an ambassador for Christ. God makes His appeal through me. I carry His word with authority and conviction.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We are therefore Christ's ambassadors, as though God were making his appeal through us. We implore you on Christ's behalf: Be reconciled to God.

declarations.text: Christ became sin so I could become the righteousness of God. I stand before the Father fully righteous, fully covered, fully His.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

declarations.text: My apostleship does not come from men or through men. It comes from Jesus Christ and God the Father. My calling is God-sourced, not man-approved.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Paul, an apostle—sent not from men nor by a man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised him from the dead.

declarations.text: Christ gave Himself for my sins to rescue me from this present evil age. I have been extracted from darkness. I operate in a different realm.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who gave himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father.

declarations.text: False brothers try to spy out my freedom in Christ and drag me back into bondage. I see through every scheme. My freedom is non-negotiable.
declarations.bibleVerseText: This matter arose because some false believers had infiltrated our ranks to spy on the freedom we have in Christ Jesus and to make us slaves.

declarations.text: I do not set aside the grace of God. Righteousness does not come through the law. If it did, Christ died for nothing. I hold fast to grace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I do not set aside the grace of God, for if righteousness could be gained through the law, Christ died for nothing!

declarations.text: I received the Spirit by faith, not by works of the law. My spiritual life was born by hearing and believing. That is where I continue.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I would like to learn just one thing from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by believing what you heard?

declarations.text: I did not begin in the Spirit only to finish by the flesh. What God started in me is carried by the same Spirit. I do not revert to striving.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Are you so foolish? After beginning by means of the Spirit, are you now trying to finish by means of the flesh?

declarations.text: Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness. I follow that same path of faith. Belief is the currency of my covenant with God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So also Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.

declarations.text: Those who walk by faith are the children of Abraham. I am a child of Abraham. Faith is my family lineage. I carry the blessing of the faithful.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Understand, then, that those who have faith are children of Abraham.

declarations.text: I am blessed along with faithful Abraham. That blessing is not earned. It is inherited by faith. I receive every facet of the Abrahamic covenant.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So those who rely on faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.

declarations.text: Christ redeemed me from the curse of the law. He became a curse for me. Every curse is broken over my life. I am redeemed and released.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us, for it is written: 'Cursed is everyone who is hung on a pole.'

declarations.text: The blessing of Abraham has come to me through Christ Jesus. I have received the promised Spirit through faith. The covenant blessing is mine today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He redeemed us in order that the blessing given to Abraham might come to the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.

declarations.text: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his Seed. That Seed is Christ. I am in Christ. Every promise God made to the Seed belongs to me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. Scripture does not say 'and to seeds,' meaning many people, but 'and to your seed,' meaning one person, who is Christ.

declarations.text: My inheritance is not based on law. It is based on promise. God gave it to Abraham by promise. That same promise-gift is mine in Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on the promise; but God in his grace gave it to Abraham through a promise.

declarations.text: Scripture locked everything under sin so that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ could be given to those who believe. I believe. The promise is mine.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But Scripture has locked up everything under the control of sin, so that what was promised, being given through faith in Jesus Christ, might be given to those who believe.

declarations.text: I was once under guardians and trustees, but that time is over. I have come into my full inheritance. I am no longer a minor waiting for permission.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The heir is subject to guardians and trustees until the time set by his father.

declarations.text: I have come to know God. More than that, I am fully known by God. I do not go back to weak and worthless things. I have tasted true freedom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But now that you know God—or rather are known by God—how is it that you are turning back to those weak and miserable forces?

declarations.text: I am not a child of the slave woman. I am a child of the free woman. I am born of the promise. My freedom is my birthright in Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, brothers and sisters, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.

declarations.text: By the Spirit, through faith, I eagerly await the righteousness for which I hope. My hope is not in effort. It is anchored in the Spirit and secured by faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For through the Spirit we eagerly await by faith the righteousness for which we hope.

declarations.text: In Christ, circumcision means nothing and uncircumcision means nothing. What counts is faith expressing itself through love. That is my operating system.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. The only thing that counts is faith expressing itself through love.

declarations.text: I was called to freedom. I do not use that freedom to indulge the flesh. I use it to serve others through love. Freedom and love are inseparable in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You, my brothers and sisters, were called to be free. But do not use your freedom to indulge the flesh; rather, serve one another humbly in love.

declarations.text: The flesh and the Spirit are in conflict. I know this. I choose the Spirit. I side with the Spirit in every battle, and the Spirit prevails in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the flesh desires what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are in conflict with each other.

declarations.text: I belong to Christ Jesus. I have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires. The flesh is nailed to the cross. The Spirit reigns in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.

declarations.text: I restore those who stumble with a spirit of gentleness. I watch myself. Restoration is my posture, not judgment. I carry others in humility.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Brothers and sisters, if someone is caught in a sin, you who live by the Spirit should restore that person gently.

declarations.text: I boast in nothing except the cross of Jesus Christ. Through that cross, the world is crucified to me and I to the world. I am a new creation in Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May I never boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

declarations.text: Circumcision counts for nothing. Uncircumcision counts for nothing. What counts is that I am a new creation in Christ. That is my identity. That is enough.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything; what counts is the new creation.

declarations.text: God calls me to holiness. Not to conform to the world but to be set apart. I walk in that calling with conviction.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For God did not call us to be impure, but to live a holy life.

declarations.text: The Lord Himself establishes and guards my heart. He is my shield against the evil one. I am protected by His faithfulness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other and for everyone else, just as ours does for you.

declarations.text: I am sober and self-controlled, clothed in faith and love as a breastplate. My helmet is the hope of salvation. I am armored for this day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on faith and love as a breastplate, and the hope of salvation as a helmet.

declarations.text: God is faithful. He calls me and He completes what He starts in me. My transformation is not my project. It is His.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.

declarations.text: I encourage others and build them up. This is how I walk worthy of my calling. My words carry life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.

declarations.text: God considers me worthy of His calling. He fulfills every good purpose and every act of faith in me by His power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With this in mind, we constantly pray for you, that our God may make you worthy of his calling, and that by his power he may bring to fruition your every desire for goodness and your every deed prompted by faith.

declarations.text: The name of Jesus is glorified in me and I am glorified in Him. This is the grace of my God at work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We pray this so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: God gives me eternal encouragement and good hope by His grace. My hope is not fragile. It is established and unshakeable.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope.

declarations.text: God chose me from the beginning for salvation through the sanctifying work of the Spirit. I am called and I am sealed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits to be saved through the sanctifying work of the Spirit.

declarations.text: The Lord of peace Himself gives me peace at all times and in every situation. He is present with me. That settles everything.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.

declarations.text: I speak words seasoned with wisdom. My lips are a wellspring of life to those who hear me. I open my mouth with instruction and my tongue teaches what is good.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

declarations.text: I fear the Lord and find a wellspring of life within that reverence. His presence is my refuge. I turn from every snare of death and walk in freedom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, turning a person from the snares of death.

declarations.text: I open my hand to the poor and extend my arms to the needy. Generosity is my nature. I give freely and I am not impoverished by it. I am enriched.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She opens her arms to the poor and extends her hands to the needy.

declarations.text: Wisdom is a tree of life in my hands and I hold her fast. Every branch bears fruit. I am blessed because I keep her close and do not let go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her; those who hold her fast will be blessed.

declarations.text: I receive correction with an open heart. Wisdom enters through reproof. I do not despise discipline. I honor the instruction of God and grow stronger for it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever heeds life-giving correction will be at home among the wise.

declarations.text: I honor the Lord with my wealth and the firstfruits of all I produce. My barns overflow because I give God the first portion. Abundance follows obedience.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Honor the Lord with your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your crops; then your barns will be filled to overflowing, and your vats will brim over with new wine.

declarations.text: I listen to counsel and accept instruction. That is the path to wisdom. I do not reject the voice of the wise. I receive it and my understanding deepens.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Listen to advice and accept discipline, and at the end you will be counted among the wise.

declarations.text: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower and I run to it. I find safety within His name. I am not left exposed. I am secure, sheltered, and unassailable.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

declarations.text: I speak what is honest and it stands as enduring testimony. Truth does not need defense. I let my words be a reliable witness and they hold firm.
declarations.bibleVerseText: An honest witness tells the truth, but a false witness tells lies.

declarations.text: I do not envy sinners. I am zealous for the fear of the Lord all day long. That holy reverence is my anchor and my hope is not cut off.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always be zealous for the fear of the Lord. There is surely a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

declarations.text: I am a faithful messenger to those who trust me. I bring refreshment to the souls of the people I serve. My reliability is a gift that God has cultivated in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Like a snow-cooled drink at harvest time is a trustworthy messenger to the one who sends him; he refreshes the spirit of his master.

declarations.text: I reject slander and I am not numbered among those who destroy with words. My mouth speaks only what builds. I am a person of proven and tested integrity.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever spreads slander is a fool.

declarations.text: I seek wise counsel before every major decision. Plans are confirmed in the company of many advisors. I do not act alone when the stakes are high.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Plans are established by seeking advice; so if you wage war, obtain guidance.

declarations.text: I hold my tongue and preserve my life. The one who speaks without restraint brings ruin. I am measured, deliberate, and precise with my words. That is my wisdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who guard their lips preserve their lives, but those who speak rashly will come to ruin.

declarations.text: I scatter generously and my wealth increases. I hold nothing back from God's purpose and I am never left wanting. Generosity is the fertile soil of abundance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: One person gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds unduly, but comes to poverty.

declarations.text: I pursue righteousness and find life, prosperity, and honor waiting for me. I do not cut corners. I run hard after God's standard and He rewards what He sees.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever pursues righteousness and love finds life, prosperity and honor.

declarations.text: Cheerfulness is medicine to my bones and strength to my soul. I choose joy as a discipline. My countenance reflects the life of God dwelling within me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

declarations.text: My integrity protects me and guides me. I do not need to manipulate or scheme. Uprightness is my navigator and I arrive at God's best through honest paths.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the unfaithful are destroyed by their duplicity.

declarations.text: I do not return evil for evil. I trust God to vindicate me. He is the one who weighs motives and repays each person according to what they have done.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not say, 'I'll pay you back for this wrong!' Wait for the Lord, and he will avenge you.

declarations.text: I seek the Lord early and I find Him. Wisdom calls out at the crossroads and I answer. I am rewarded because I diligently and earnestly search for God's face.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I love those who love me, and those who seek me find me.

declarations.text: My words are chosen with care because life and death are at stake. I speak with purpose and precision. What flows from my mouth reflects the treasure of God inside me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The words of the reckless pierce like swords, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.

declarations.text: I fear the Lord and depart from evil. That is wisdom. That is understanding. I do not chase popular opinion. I pursue the unchanging standard of God's revealed truth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To fear the Lord is to hate evil; I hate pride and arrogance, evil behavior and perverse speech.

declarations.text: I am a person of genuine friendship. I stay close in adversity. I am the kind of friend who is born for times of difficulty. I do not vanish when it gets hard.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for a time of adversity.

declarations.text: I incline my ear to wisdom and apply my heart to understanding. I call out for insight. I search for her as for hidden treasure and I find the knowledge of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you call out for insight and cry aloud for understanding, and if you look for it as for silver and search for it as for hidden treasure, then you will understand the fear of the Lord and find the knowledge of God.

declarations.text: I am not moved by the fear of man. I trust in the Lord and I am kept secure. My confidence is not in what people think of me. It is in God who holds me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Fear of man will prove to be a snare, but whoever trusts in the Lord is kept safe.
